title: Model services catalog, presets, read-only discovery, endpoint path styles, allowance billing profile, Claude Code coding-plan bridge, registered-provider foreman
summary: Operator request 2026-10-12: choose among subscription, hosted open-weight and abliterated models. Implemented through Orchestrator runs ms-foundation, ms-services and ms-catalog-claude (Codex implementers until its quota ran out, then Claude; reviews by the other provider where available). endpoints.py adds path_style auto/root/append_v1; legacy base URLs are unchanged, and bases already ending in /vN are no longer doubled. model_profile adds billing and privacy blocks: is_paid stays true for metered, credit and GPU billing and for allowances whose overage is metered or unknown. Only an allowance with overage 'blocked' counts as unpaid, so the allow_paid_spend gate is not weakened. The claude_code adapter accepts options.env (ANTHROPIC_/CLAUDE_ names only, no key/token/secret names) and options.secret_env, and strips the operator's ANTHROPIC_* credentials whenever a bridge is configured. model_services.py loads and validates the source-backed catalog (28 services, 20 models, 9 media; 0 errors). Presets refuse automation_allowed=false and client-restricted plans, and need --ack-terms when the terms are unclear. Presets always set a secret_ref, so a cloud vendor key never reaches a third-party host (a high-severity review finding, fixed before integration). discover is GET-only and sends Authorization only to the endpoint's own host. The GUI gains a Model services panel; foreman use registered makes any eligible registered provider the session foreman, with paid gating unchanged.
